Select IC50 activity records for the human single-protein target Aromatase (CHEMBL1978). Return columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback docs.doi), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Join path: activities -> assays on assay_id (indexed), assays -> target_dictionary on tid, activities -> molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary -> compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN, non-null canonical_smiles required), activities -> compound_records on record_id, compound_records -> docs on doc_id (non-null pubmed_id or doi required). Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1978', activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Keep all qualifying activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
